description: This file defines classes and interfaces for managing SSL/TLS certificates, keys, certificate stores, and secure socket ports within the Thunder::Crypto namespace. It includes class declarations for Certificate, Key, CertificateStore, and SecureSocketPort, along with nested Handler class for socket operations, and template class SecureSocketServerType for server configurations.

classes.name: Certificate
classes.description: Represents an X.509 certificate, providing methods to access issuer, subject, validity period, and hostname validation.

classes.name: Key
classes.description: Represents a cryptographic key, with constructors for loading from a file or directly from a key structure.

classes.name: CertificateStore
classes.description: Manages a store of certificates, allowing addition and retrieval, with a default store.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort
classes.description: Provides a secure socket port implementation with nested Handler class for managing SSL/TLS connections, including certificate validation and data transmission.

classes.name: SecureSocketServerType<CLIENT>
classes.description: Template class for server configuration with associated certificate and key.

methods.name: Certificate()
methods.description: Constructor for Certificate class, either default or copy/move.

methods.name: Issuer()
methods.description: Returns the issuer of the certificate.

methods.name: Subject()
methods.description: Returns the subject of the certificate.

methods.name: ValidFrom()
methods.description: Returns the start time of certificate validity.

methods.name: ValidTill()
methods.description: Returns the end time of certificate validity.

methods.name: ValidHostname()
methods.description: Checks if the certificate is valid for a given hostname.

methods.name: Key()
methods.description: Constructor for Key class, either default or copy/move, or from file.

methods.name: Add()
methods.description: Adds a certificate to the store.

methods.name: CertificateStore::operator const x509_store_st* ()
methods.description: Conversion operator to external x509 store.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Certificate()
methods.description: Sets the certificate and key for the secure socket port.
